title: 1850亿美元塔塔：董事投票反对创始家族，控制权争夺转向更低层级
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Jaguar Land Rover, Tetley D, Air India, Taj hotel.
segments.zh: 捷豹路虎、泰特莱茶、印度航空、泰姬酒店。

segments.en: These seemingly random but well-known brands have something in common.
segments.zh: 这些看似随机但知名的品牌有一个共同点。

segments.en: They're all owned by one of India's biggest conglomerates.
segments.zh: 它们都属于印度最大的企业集团之一。

segments.en: The Dada Group is not just any conglomerate. They had a total group revenue of $185 billion.
segments.zh: 塔塔集团不是普通的企业集团。其总营收达1850亿美元。

segments.en: That shows the extent of its sway on the Indian economy.
segments.zh: 这显示了其对印度经济的影响力。

segments.en: It makes cars, it makes salt, chemicals, software, iPhones.
segments.zh: 它制造汽车、盐、化学品、软件、iPhone。

segments.en: They make almost everything. But Tata is facing an internal battle for control that threatens its future.
segments.zh: 它们几乎制造一切。但塔塔正面临内部的控制权争夺，威胁其未来。

segments.en: And potentially with it, Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ambitions to make India a global manufacturing hub.
segments.zh: 并可能影响总理纳伦德拉·莫迪将印度打造成全球制造中心的雄心。

segments.en: India's Tata Group are facing a fresh uncertainty. It's a very, very shocking kind of situation.
segments.zh: 印度塔塔集团正面临新的不确定性。这是非常令人震惊的情况。

segments.en: The Tata's are undergoing a very unusual past struggle.
segments.zh: 塔塔正在经历一场非常不寻常的过往斗争。

segments.en: It's about who really controls the power center of the Tata Group.
segments.zh: 关键在于谁真正掌控塔塔集团的权力中心。

segments.en: That is, fighting for control of the conglomerate has moved to lower up.
segments.zh: 也就是说，对这家企业集团控制权的争夺已转向更低层级。

segments.en: What happens will impact not just the stakeholders in India, but also its companies overseas and large swathes of investors who are looking at the Indian business, but also the larger Indian economy.
segments.zh: 后续发展不仅影响印度的利益相关者，还会波及该集团的海外公司，以及关注印度商业和更广泛印度经济的众多市场参与者。

segments.en: Shocking part of Tata's story is where set of directors have voted against a founding family.
segments.zh: 塔塔故事中令人震惊的部分是，部分董事投票反对创始家族。
